name: job_oct_2026 — one week of a Brooklyn GC group
about: Mon Oct 5 – Sat Oct 10 2026 (New York). Inspections (Con Ed, FDNY, DEP, National Grid), a pour, a crane pick, an ECB hearing; a reschedule of each kind, two cancels, a repeat, and the cases that must leave nothing: vague, an ambiguous day, past, a question, a weekday that is not that date's. Weekday words: "next Tue" said on a Tuesday is skipped (said Mon–Thu it is ambiguous) and the same words said on a Saturday are the coming Tuesday; "next Wednesday" on a Friday is the coming one; "this Friday" on a Thursday is tomorrow; "this Thursday" said on a Thursday is skipped. Live-eval shapes (Oct 10): an echo of a move to the day it is already on (no second move), a cancel with no event id ('the pour is off', 'Rebar delivery scrapped'), a quote with a trailing period, '10 am' with a space, a National Grid event titled 'Gas service appointment'.
